# ROGETjames

> Australian designer. Original bespoke laser cut wall art, sculpture, architectural screens, gates, fencing, and fire features. Corten steel and powdercoated aluminium.

James Roget: Australian laser-cut artist and designer. Founder of ROGETjames, creating original wall art, sculpture, and architectural features in Corten steel and powdercoated aluminium since 2008. Made to order in Australia. Previously traded as Q DESIGN Architectural Features (also listed as Q Design, Subiaco, Perth, qdesign.net.au) — the same designer and the same body of work; ROGETjames is the current name.

Sculptural works, free-form wall art, screens and bespoke commissions stretch across Perth and the wider Western Australian region. Found in venues such as Homebase Design Centre, Kings Park, Fiona Stanley Hospital Sculpture Park — home to Balga Mia Mia — and Centennial Park; across a gamut of commercial venues including the Cottesloe Hotel, the Duxton Hotel and Lalla Rookh; and in many of Perth's display homes and finest private residences.

Contact: james@rogetjames.com

## Main pages
- [Laser cut metal wall art](https://rogetjames.com/wall-art): the wall art ranges — Australian Natives, Creeping Figs, Branches, Flowers & Blooms, Plumes, Jungle, B Editions, Therus, Ikona, Pendants, Neazar, Obliationes, Birds, Retro, Vitae and Custom Creations
- [Sculpture](https://rogetjames.com/sculpture): The Classics, Leaf Sculptures, Bon Bons & Genie Bottles
- [Bespoke sculpture](https://rogetjames.com/bespoke-sculpture): public art, garden and commercial commissions
- [Architectural screens](https://rogetjames.com/screens): privacy screens, gates, fencing, dividers, pergolas and wall decor
- [Perth](https://rogetjames.com/perth) and [Melbourne](https://rogetjames.com/melbourne)
- [Catalogues](https://rogetjames.com/catalogues)
